title: artifact-content
description: The artifact-content READER protocol: how the piece that holds Drive references (the detection side) hands raw artifact bytes to the piece that summarizes one meeting (the per-meeting job). One tagged union — the request names a drive-ref, the result carries the decoded text plus the two verdicts a consumer cannot re-derive from the bytes alone: which KIND of artifact this is (a transcript, or auxiliary meeting notes) and whether it is LEGIBLE. goal.md clause 5 turns on legibility and clause 19 turns on the kind, so both are reader output, never consumer guesswork.

oneOf.description: read-request: fetch the bytes behind one drive-ref. Carries no expectation of what will come back — telling a transcript from a notes file is the reader's job, and a request that pre-declares the kind would let the caller's guess override the reader's reading.

name.description: the artifact's display name as the source carries it, when the caller has it; the reader uses it as one kind signal and never as an identity

oneOf.description: read-result: the decoded artifact and the reader's two verdicts

media-type.description: the artifact's media type as the source reports it (e.g. text/markdown); the legibility verdict is justified against it

text.description: the decoded artifact, whole; empty exactly when the artifact carries no text

sha256.description: digest of the decoded text, so a re-read of the same artifact is recognisable as the same bytes

legible.description: false when the bytes could not be decoded into usable text; clause 5's Meet-over-Tactiq rule applies only where BOTH sources are legible, so this verdict is what makes that condition checkable

illegible-reason.description: present when legible is false; names what defeated the read, as the failure note will say it

artifact-kind.description: transcript: an utterance record of the meeting; meeting-notes: an auxiliary notes artifact (a Gemini notes file), auxiliary input only and never a trigger on its own (clause 19); undetermined: the reader could not tell, which is a failure event and never a default to transcript
